_rationale: git_analysis had no e2e coverage, but a positive-path golden is impossible here: the corpus sits inside the live lci-cpp repo, so staged/commit scopes reflect whatever the developer has in flight (verified: a staged corpus edit grows top-level duplicates/naming_issues arrays). The deterministic pin is the fail-fast leg -- an invalid scope must error loudly with isError=true, proving dispatch reaches the real handler's validation rather than a stub.
